sources.title: A3ON-1B-GGUF Open-source Model - Supports text generation and code ...
sources.snippet: A statically quantized version of the A3ON-1B model, suitable for tasks such as text generation and code assistance. This model is based on the kaiiddo/A3ON-1B base model and offers multiple quantization versions to meet different performance requirements.
